# CSU Stanislaus University Library

> The comprehensive digital hub for CSU Stanislaus library services, collections, and research resources across Turlock and Stockton campuses.

CSU Stanislaus University Library serves students, faculty, and staff with research support, circulation services, special collections, and academic resources. The library operates multiple campus locations and provides access to physical collections, digital exhibits, and specialized services including interlibrary loan and course reserves.

## Key Topics

- Library Collections
- Circulation Services
- Interlibrary Loan
- Course Reserves
- Special Collections & University Archives
- Study Space & Facilities
- Computer Commons
- Faculty Services

- Stockton Campus Library
- Disability Resource Services
- Federal Depository Library Program

## Getting Started

- [University Library Homepage](https://library.csustan.edu/home): CSU Stanislaus University Library homepage with research resources and guides
- [About Our Library](https://library.csustan.edu/about): About CSU Stanislaus University Library mission, vision, and services
- [Contact Us](https://library.csustan.edu/contact): Contact information for CSU Stanislaus University Library staff
- [Library Calendar & Hours](https://library.csustan.edu/calendar): CSU Stanislaus library hours, academic calendar, and holiday schedule

## Collections & Resources

- [Library Collections](https://library.csustan.edu/collections): CSU Stanislaus library collections guide including course reserves
- [Special Collections & University Archives](https://library.csustan.edu/specialcollections): Special collections and university archives at CSU Stanislaus
- [Digital Exhibitions](https://library.csustan.edu/digital-exhibits): Digital exhibitions and special collections from CSU Stanislaus

## Library Services

- [Circulation Services](https://library.csustan.edu/circ): Circulation services including borrowing, returns, and interlibrary loan
- [Interlibrary Loan](https://library.csustan.edu/ill): Interlibrary loan request guide and document delivery services
- [Course Reserves](https://library.csustan.edu/course-reserves): Course reserves information for students and faculty
- [Computer & Technology Services](https://library.csustan.edu/computers): Computer facilities, laptop checkout, and printing services guide
- [Study Space Reservations](https://library.csustan.edu/study-space): Study space reservation and library facilities information

## User-Specific Services

- [Faculty Services](https://library.csustan.edu/faculty-services): Faculty services including instruction, research, and liaison support
- [Graduate Student Services](https://library.csustan.edu/graduate-services): Graduate student services for thesis, dissertation, and research

## Library Locations & Facilities

- [Stockton Campus Library](https://library.csustan.edu/stockton-library): Stockton Campus Library services, hours, and resources
- [Floor Plans](https://library.csustan.edu/floorplans): Floor plans for J. Burton Vaschè and Stockton Campus Libraries
